district_name: Taconic and Green Regional School District

jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(4)(A) inventory: Taconic and Green Regional School District, a unified union district in the Bennington Rutland Supervisory Union (member towns: Danby, Dorset, Landgrove, Londonderry, Manchester, Mt. Tabor, Peru, Sunderland, Weston). Operates PK-8; tuitions grades 9-12.

board.org_name: Taconic and Green Regional School Board
board.post_note: Taconic and Green RSD: thirteen directors, residency-reserved (one per member town plus four reserved for residents of Danby, Dorset, Londonderry and Manchester), all elected district-wide by Australian ballot (modified at-large).

sources.note: Taconic and Green RSD Special Meeting Warning, Sept. 21, 2026 (official; signed by the board): the current 13-member roster -- Wilson (Chair), Freeman (Vice Chair), Chandler (Clerk), Dale, Langsett, Lechthaler, Moskowitz, Ralph, Salsgiver, Thompson, Tuff, Wilde, J. Wilson -- and the district's nine member towns verbatim. The election model and four ends are proven by the certified March 2025 results recorded in Weston's town meeting minutes: four directors from any of the four largest towns (Danby, Dorset, Londonderry, Manchester) elected district-wide to 3-year terms expiring March 2028 -- Wilson (1,081), Chandler (1,021), Ralph (960), Moskowitz (935) -- and a Peru seat voted district-wide (Agneesens, 2,462 votes) for a 1-year term expiring March 2026: modified at-large with residency-reserved seats (one per member town plus four reserved for residents of the four largest towns). Agneesens does not appear on the Sept. 2026 roster -- recorded ended 2026. Debra Lyneis (Weston's director through 2025) is likewise absent, but her departure is undocumented -- no record minted. Ends and towns for the other nine members are published in no fetched source (resolving document: the FY27 district Annual Report board table or the March 2026 certified results). Freeman is Landgrove's director per Landgrove's March 2, 2026 town meeting minutes.
